about: [O7] The phone box by real keys: at a call box (a tool's teleport) with no money, E: the phone clicks, '$50 for a car', nothing taken; with $50 (the bed's 8), 'E  call for a car  $50', E: the money gone, the line 'A car is coming.'; a while later a coupe at the kerb by the box, 'Your car.', its ring on the minimap; walk to it and E: in, the line gone. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o7_phone.json

steps.eval: (() => { const B = G.night.phone.setup(); const e = G.eye; const b = B.slice().sort((a, c) => Math.hypot(a.x - e.x, a.z - e.z) - Math.hypot(c.x - e.x, c.z - e.z))[0]; window.__box = b; const nx = Math.sin(b.yaw || 0), nz = Math.cos(b.yaw || 0); let px = b.x + 1.2, pz = b.z; for (const [dx, dz] of [[1.2, 0], [-1.2, 0], [0, 1.2], [0, -1.2]]) { const q = new N.THREE.Vector3(b.x + dx, 0, b.z + dz); G.stage.colliders.resolve(q, 0.3); if (Math.hypot(q.x - b.x - dx, q.z - b.z - dz) < 0.05) { px = q.x; pz = q.z; break; } } N.controller.setPose(px, pz, Math.atan2(-(b.x - px), -(b.z - pz)), -0.1); void nx; void nz; return [b.x, b.z]; })()

steps.label: with $50: E  call for a car
the money gone, 'A car is coming.'
a car brought to the kerb

steps.expect: G.hud.objectiveText === 'Your car.' && !!G.night.target && G.city.car === G.night.phone.order.car && Math.hypot(G.city.car.pos.x - window.__box.x, G.city.car.pos.z - window.__box.z) < 45
steps.label: 'Your car.', its ring, by the box

steps.walk: (() => { const c = G.city.car, p = N.controller.pos, k = Math.sign((p.x - c.pos.x) * Math.sin(c.yaw) + (p.z - c.pos.z) * Math.cos(c.yaw)) || 1; return [[c.pos.x + Math.sin(c.yaw) * 2.4 * k, c.pos.z + Math.cos(c.yaw) * 2.4 * k]]; })()

steps.label: in: the line and the ring gone
